rationale: Pairwise multiplexed (dual-guide) CRISPR screen of 14 mitophagy receptors in MOLM-13 (MTH01) AML cells (Meyer et al., Autophagy 2023). Each deposited construct is a pair of guides (Guide_1 x Guide_2); per-sample CSVs (GSE211073_RAW.tar) were merged on the construct pair. Counts are raw integers. For a single-construct abundance analysis each construct is a unit and its 'gene' is the non-control gene it targets: control+control -> control (144 non-targeting-like constructs, used for calibration), gene+control or gene+same-gene -> that single gene (112 constructs each, 14 receptors), gene A + gene B -> an A_B pair label. The mitophagy reporter sort (mito-Keima) is read out as high vs low fractions after DFP (deferiprone) or OA (oligomycin+antimycin A) induction, 3 replicates each; receptors required for mitophagy deplete in the high fraction. IMPORTANT: this is a genetic-interaction screen whose published conclusions rest on interaction scores between guide PAIRS (epistasis), which BARCS's single-gene guide-aggregation model does not represent; only the single-gene (control-paired) abundance changes are interpretable here, and the A_B pair labels are aggregated as nominal genes but their interaction scores are out of scope.
